notes: TopModul DTS variant support v328. Existing TopModul maps are treated as DTS4. New TopModul (DTS3) maps keep physical machine geometry at 0-360 degrees but present/edit/export RPC table angles on the legacy 0-45 degree command domain (8 physical degrees per 1 DTS3 RPC table degree). Adds 4-decimal DTS3 table-angle precision and preserves TopModul family validation.
